description: 确定性 IANA 时区换算与跨国会议时段规划（含夏令时消歧）/ Deterministic IANA timezone converter & meeting window planner. mode is auto-inferred when omitted. Examples: convert={"dateTime":"2026-06-15 12:00","sourceTimeZone":"Asia/Shanghai","targetTimeZones":["America/New_York","Europe/London"]}; meeting={"date":"2026-06-15","participants":[{"timeZone":"Asia/Shanghai"},{"timeZone":"America/New_York"}]}.

date.description: 【convert/meeting】日期 YYYY-MM-DD（meeting 模式必填）/ Date YYYY-MM-DD

dateTime.description: 【convert】基准当地日期时间 / Local date-time, e.g. "2026-06-15 12:00"

includeSlots.description: 【meeting】是否返回全天 slots 明细（默认 false）/ Include full day slots

mode.description: 可选模式（省略时自动推断）/ Optional mode: convert | meeting

participants.description: 【meeting】2–12 位参与者时区配置 / 2-12 participants

label.description: 城市或成员备注名 / Optional label

timeZone.description: 参与者 IANA 时区 ID, e.g. Asia/Shanghai

workEndHour.description: 工作结束小时（1–24，默认 18）/ Work end hour

workStartHour.description: 工作开始小时（0–23，默认 9）/ Work start hour

sourceTimeZone.description: 【convert】基准 IANA 时区 / Source IANA TZ, e.g. Asia/Shanghai

stepMinutes.description: 【meeting】步长：60（默认）或 30 分钟 / Step minutes: 60 | 30

targetTimeZones.description: 【convert】1–12 个目标 IANA 时区（支持单字符串或数组）/ Target IANA TZ string or array, e.g. ["America/New_York"]

time.description: 【convert】时间 HH:mm（配合 date 使用，默认 09:00）/ Time HH:mm

name: convert_timezone
title: 时区换算与跨国会议时间（妙用盒）
